alt: 親切的年長校長坐在校園長椅上，與孩子平視交談，耐心聆聽孩子介紹手中的花朵圖畫。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 平易近人 means a person of authority is warm, unpretentious and easy to approach. Contemporary elementary school courtyard. A friendly gray-haired female school principal in simple neat cardigan and trousers sits on a low garden bench at the same eye level as two schoolchildren, warmly smiling and listening to a child who confidently shows her a simple drawing of a flower on an otherwise blank sheet. Her relaxed posture and open welcoming gesture make her approachable. One child stands naturally beside her, the other sits on the bench nearby, both relaxed and comfortable speaking directly with this senior educator. An open school office doorway and simple school building in background establish her role without writing or signage; no desk barrier, no elevated throne, no intimidating formality. All figures anatomically natural, each person exactly two arms and two legs, hands clearly attached and unobstructed, bench supports grounded, feet resting naturally on ground. Keep composition uncluttered, just three people, no speech bubbles, no labels or text.
